items.name: Bangladesh Cubing Fiesta 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjQzMDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--2ab56a8c6da5dbf1d490edcc0dbd22218b0c579d/Cube%20Fiesta%20Logo%20PNG-01%20r.png) 1. The competition will take place at the [BU Permanent Campus](https://goo.gl/maps/BwsAkDbcdVLMLCLW9), not on any other campuses spread across Mohammadpur. 2. You'll have to be present at the competition area at least 10 minutes before the start of your event. 3. All the necessary information is given the Tabs, please have a look. 4. Join [CubistBD](https://www.facebook.com/groups/cubingbangladesh/) to get updates.

items.name: Nepali Nationals 2025

venue.name: Nepal Academy of Tourism and Hotel Management (NATHM)
venue.address: Nepal Academy of Tourism and Hotel Management (NATHM) Rabi Bhawan, Kathmandu

items.information: This competition is the fifth iteration of the Nepali National Championship and is open to competitors of all nationalities. However, only Nepalese participants will be eligible for Prizes and Titles.
